_comment: Copy to agent/config.json (gitignored) and fill in. Any field left as-is keeps the default. You can also set HOMEGUARD_* env vars instead.

remediation._comment: dry_run=true -> the agent logs the firewall command it WOULD run and never changes the system. Set false to actually block the attacker IP (netsh on Windows / iptables on Linux). Only private/loopback IPs are ever eligible.

email._comment: Gmail requires a 16-char App Password (Google Account > Security > App passwords), not your normal password. For the email 'Confirm' link to be clickable from another device, run the agent with --api-host 0.0.0.0 and set api_public_base to http://<laptopA_LAN_ip>:8001.

telegram._comment: Create a bot with @BotFather to get bot_token. Get chat_id by messaging your bot then visiting https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates. Telegram is the easiest confirm channel: inline Yes/No buttons, no inbound server needed.
